g.text: Sosie Bacon Joins Nikolaj Coster-Waldau in ‘Black Tapes’ Series at MGM+ ◆ Netflix Grapples With Digital-Ad Squeeze Amid Widening Glut of Streaming Commercials ◆ Christina Applegate Tells MS Community ‘I’m Still Your Warrior’ After Being Misdiagnosed: ‘I’m Going to Speak Out on Your Behalf Forever’ ◆ Billy Bob Thornton Examines Mayflower Voyage in Fox Nation Documentary Series ◆ ‘Miraculous: Tales of Ladybug & Cat Noir’ Sets Global Season 7 Rollout on Disney, TF1 and Globo ◆ Susan Saint James, Emmy-Winning Star of ‘Kate & Allie’ and ‘McMillan & Wife,’ Dies at 80 ◆
